channel.title: US Top News and Analysis

item.description: U.S. presidents have increasingly ordered massive releases from the SPR in recent years.

item.description: The market's moves come amid growing doubts that the U.S. and Iran will come to a lasting resolution to the conflict in the near term.

item.description: The order builds on the Trump administration's efforts to reshape the childhood shot schedule under HHS Secretary RFK Jr., a longtime a vaccine skeptic.

item.description: The company introduced Daybreak in May as a way for its ecosystem partners to use its most advanced AI models to adapt to a rapidly changing threat landscape.

item.description: The tremor was felt in Colombia's capital, Bogota, and as far away as Venezuela.

item.description: Gold logged its best weekly gain in seven months driven by several forces.

item.title: Wednesday’s crucial CPI report will show tamer inflation, according to prediction markets

item.description: The Capital One Savor's $250 cash-back bonus is ending soon. We cover how to earn the bonus and how it compares to other cash-back cards.

item.title: Santoli: Stocks return to winning ways. Why the market gods may not be satisfied with July's brief pain
item.description: The stock market's winning history – a hit rate of 100% over any past 20-year span - is well understood. But investors recognize – or need to – the genuine hazard in equities.

item.title: House Dems call for AI companies to testify on recent hacks: ‘Clear risk to safety’

item.title: World's biggest chipmaker TSMC's sales surge 45% amid buoyant AI demand

item.title: Student loan borrowers face steeper 'marriage penalty' under new repayment plan

item.title: Interest rates may stay higher for longer. What that means for consumers

item.title: Shein faces existential threat as tariffs hit low-price model, putting new focus on services

item.title: Australian rare earth miner surges after U.S. Department of Defense investment
